notes: Block senders, report spam, and keep texts private behind a passphrase.

changes.text: Block a sender. Their texts are sealed away, with no notification. You can also block by prefix, pattern or word.
Hide messages or whole conversations, and keep a number private: its texts then arrive only in your private space, with a plain "New message" alert.
Report spam. The conversation moves to Spam, stays silent, and is deleted 30 days after its last text. Not spam puts it back.
Send as new: send a message's words again as a new text.
Tap a message to see when it was sent and delivered, and on which SIM.
On two-SIM phones, choose the SIM for texts in Settings, or be asked each time.
Pressing and holding a message now keeps it selected.
